description:
Where Light Becomes Motion. Where Civilization Comes Alive.

From structure came life.

After the systems were built, Mars evolved. Cities rose. Energy ignited. Light began to flow across the surface — forming a new world alive with movement, culture, and expression. From this emergence, the Mars Lumina was created.

Mars Lumina represents the living future of Mars — bold, electric, and unapologetically expressive. Its aero carbon design is built for speed, efficiency, and cutting-edge performance, slicing through wind with precision while maintaining control and stability.

The striking neon yellow and black contrast, layered with graffiti-inspired elements, reflects the pulse of a futuristic city — raw energy, individuality, and the spirit of a new generation.

Fast, aggressive, and visually unapologetic, Mars Lumina is made for riders who don’t just follow the road — they define it.

Mars Lumina is not just a bike.

It is the light of a new world in motion.

The new Voodoo Mars Lumina is an aero bike for modern cycling. From the clean looks provided by the fully internal routing; to 32mm tire clearance for better rolling resistance and extra comfort; UDH to provide compatibility with the most modern drivetrains; and a T47 BB shell for the convenience of home mechanics.

In scientific terms, the word lumina refers to cavities or open spaces, usually in conduct-like organs. We designed Mars Lumina to help you ride through the wind with less effort. To make you feel you found a lumina in the air that makes you reach that extra speed we love to feel while riding.
